senses.gloss:
ITA-5.76.111 matta mūrcchitayora āsthāpanasya vyāpadaḥ मत्त मूर्च्छितयोर आस्थापनस्य व्यापदः
Condition caused by medicated non oily enema administered to person who is intoxicated, swooning
A condition characterized by mental damage.

ITA-3.16.25 mātṛkā (marma) मातृका (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) on the neck
Eight in number and leads to sudden death when injured.

ITA-4.2.13 mātṛjarogaḥ मातृजरोगः
Hereditary diseases of maternal origin
Hereditary conditions inherited through the maternal genetic line due to morbidity of the ovum.

ITA-6.2.7.13 mātrā मात्रा
Dose or measure

ITA-9.2.74 mātrābastiḥ मात्राबस्तिः
Low-dose ghee or oily enema
A medicated enema given in a dose which will not cause complications even if retained or the posttherapy regimen is not followed.

ITA-1.9.3.3.23 mātsaryam मात्सर्यम्
Discontentment
A state of being discontent with one’s state of affairs, being envious, competitive.

ITA-2.8.28 matsyakāyaḥ मात्स्यकायः
Person with timid, unintelligent temperament
The characteristics of the person with a timid, unintelligent temperament are fickleness and instability, foolishness, cowardice, affinity for water, and a tendency to fight with people of a similar type.
